title: Hire signal synthesis and risk log template
content:
Purpose:
- Quick, repeatable synthesis template for interview panels and hiring managers to capture signals, unresolved risks, and next-step comms after candidate debriefs.
- Designed for DS/ML/FE/BE engineering roles and adaptable to PM/Design with minimal edits.

When to use:
- Immediately after final-round debrief or hiring-committee discussion.
- Before making an offer or closing the loop with candidate.

One-line summary (for Slack + offer thread):
- Candidate fit summary (1 sentence): e.g. 'Strong systems engineer with infra bias; strength in scale design, unknown on long-term product tradeoffs; recommended for hire with IC4 hire band.'

Signal breakdown (panel members: list top 3 bullets each):
- Technical correctness: list concrete examples where candidate demonstrated skill or missed it.
- Ownership & product sense: evidence from behavioral questions.
- Collaboration: cross-team signals, conflict handling examples.
- Growth runway: likely promotion path and time-to-impact.

Decision rubric (place an X) — use simple banding: Strong Hire | Hire | Neutral | No Hire
- Core role competency (algorithms/system design/code quality)
- Domain-specific competency (ML infra, embeddings, GPUs, cloud infra)
- Communication & collaboration
- Operations & reliability mindset (on-call comfort, debugging)
- Comp / culture fit / leadership potential

Top 3 risks (explicit):
- Risk 1: description, severity (High/Med/Low), mitigations (offer gating, shadow week, probation outcomes).
- Risk 2: description, severity, mitigations.
- Risk 3: description, severity, mitigations.

Open questions to resolve before offer:
- Tech question(s) to validate (owner + deadline): e.g., "follow-up test on distributed KV design" — owner: interviewer name, due: date.
- Reference check focus areas (who will call + 72h turnaround).

Operational next steps (owners & timeline):
- Compensation bucket suggestion (AM/SM/Notes) — owner: hiring manager.
- Recruiter to confirm notice period + start date window — owner: recruiter.
- People Ops to prepare standard offer template or exec comp approval — owner: Samira K.
- Optional: set up canary 30/60/90 plan if hire accepted — owner: hiring manager.

Immediate candidate comms snippets (copy-paste friendly):
- Positive close (if hiring): 'Thanks again for your time — we enjoyed meeting you. We need a short follow-up on [area], and expect to send an offer by [date].'
- Decline close: 'Thanks for meeting us. We appreciated your time; we won't be moving forward but will share feedback if you're interested.'

Probation & early integration gating checklist (first 45 days):
- Day 0: equipment + access checklist (cloud accounts, repo access, Slack, calendar).
- Week 1: onboarding buddy assigned; shadow schedule set; small triage ticket assigned.
- Weeks 2–4: technical ramp goals (3 concrete tasks), ticket completion, pairing sessions logged.
- End of month 1: 1:1 with manager to assess progress and unblock.
- End of month 1.5: formal check-in to confirm mitigation of any hiring risks.

Template examples (fill-in sections):
- Candidate name: 
- Role / Level: 
- Interview date: 
- Panel members: 
- One-line summary: 
- Signals (bullets): 
- Decision: (Strong Hire / Hire / Neutral / No Hire)
- Top 3 risks + mitigations: 
- Next steps + owners + dates: 

Notes to people-ops / recruiting partners (internal):
- If any high severity risk remains, convert offer to 6-month probation with documented milestones.
- For senior ICs, include explicit evaluation criteria for first 90 days in offer pack.
- Keep CC list minimal for candidate comms; escalate comp exceptions through People Ops lead.

Common friction patterns we've seen (examples):
- Strong technical signals but low collaboration evidence — mitigation: team-based pairing trial week.
- Great interview performance, sparse reference signal — mitigation: targeted reference questions and extended notice.
- Compensation mismatch — mitigation: present clear growth/comp roadmap and retention bonus cadence.

Unresolved / discussion items (working):
- Should we standardize the "probation" language across roles globally? (Regulation in EU vs US HR constraints) — action: Priya to draft legal-safe wording by 2026-01-20.
- How to record pairing trial outcomes in the HRIS — SRE to propose tagging convention in HRIS by 2026-02-01.

Quick links & examples:
- Standard offer letter template: CONFLUENCE-98765
- Hiring committee rubric (canonical): CONFLUENCE-hrt-552
- Example 30/60/90 for infra hires: github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding/infra-30-60-90
